title: Questlog Quest Book
description: Adds a simple quest book item for Questlog, like FTB Quest's quest book item!
body:
This mod adds a simple quest book item to open the [Questlog](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/questlog) menu! Created for MarbledHubbStudios.

Credit for the quest book texture, also used in the icon / logo, to [MarbledNull](https://www.curseforge.com/members/marblednull/projects).
